incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered alert `high-serving-latency-v2` in us-west-2 (pd_incident_87321) — p95 spike > 700ms for ~30s. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/87321

anna (oncall): Acked. I'm checking the console and traces now.

anna (oncall): Dashboard shows a ~40s blip in router p95, but error rate stayed flat. No 5xx spike in public routes.

miguel (sre): Looking at host metrics — small autoscaler churn on dedicated pool + KV prefill on a few nodes. CPU on router nodes jumped then settled.

miguel (sre): quick metrics snippet:
```
p95_latency: 760ms -> 210ms (after 35s)\nrouter_cpu: 88% -> 46%\nrequest_rate: +2.1x for 45s\nredis_errors: 0\n```

raj (eng): Sounds like a transient capacity warmup. Any sign of model container OOM / restarts?

miguel (sre): No container restarts. Some containers reported longer startup bundles for KV load. Correlates with scheduled canary prefill that kicked ~08:12.

lina (support): No incoming customer reports to the queue. I've checked the top product dashboards — no perceived user impact.

anna (oncall): Good. I'll leave it acked and watch for recurrence for the next 10m. If it clears, we'll let PD auto-resolve.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert `high-serving-latency-v2` auto-resolved (duration: 44s).

anna (oncall): Auto-resolve seen. Marking as no-customer-impact for now.

miguel (sre): Filing a short follow-up: adjust canary prefill window + add KV-prefill staggering to avoid simultaneous heavy prefill across router pool. Will attach graphs.

raj (eng): Optional: consider a soft suppression rule for this alert when the source is known canary prefill. But prefer fixing the prefill schedule.

lina (support): I'll add a note to the on-call handoff doc so support sees this pattern if it reappears.

anna (oncall): Thanks all. If nothing re-fires in 15m I'll close the thread and file the follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:

miguel (sre): Created ticket INF-4521 with initial triage and graphs. Linking in case PD flutters: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521

anna (oncall): Closing watch for now. Reopen if PD pings again. :eyes:
